description: Fall damage without knockback (#143): three players and three pigs fall from 4, 10 and 23 blocks onto flat grass at noon. Fall damage is in the no_knockback tag: position and motion per tick show the straight fall and landing (no sideways push), health shows the damage (the pig from 23 blocks dies; players take fall damage only with client moves). After the landing a pig attacks the 4-block player (knockback that then decays) and the 10-block player takes generic damage (no knockback).
